# Ipile Earth Synergy Construction Limited

> Modern Nigerian construction company established in 2017. We provide suitable and affordable homes in a sustainable environment using Compressed Earth Brick (CEB) and locally available resources, for every class of society.

Mission: To become the leading provider of affordable homes in Nigeria.
Core values: Innovation, Speed, Cost Effectiveness, Teamwork.

Office: Abba Father Estate off Estate 15, Estate 15, Redemption Camp, Lagos-Ibadan Expressway, Nigeria
Phone: +234 812 686 8754, +234 808 932 1462
Email: ipileearth1@gmail.com
Website: https://www.ipileearth.com.ng

## Services
- [Construction Services](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/services/construction): Civil construction, building contracting, infrastructure and public works, materials and equipment
- [Building Maintenance](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/services/building-maintenance): Renovation, structural repairs, finishing and decoration
- [Structural Design & Development](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/services/structural-design): Design, planning, consultancy and turnkey development
- [Property & Facility Management](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/services/property-facility-management): Facility management, estate management, real estate development
- [General Contracts & Procurement](https://www.ipileearth.com.ng/services/general-contracts-procurement): General contracting, supply, logistics and procurement
